commands.checks: Engine-integrity diff against the pinned corrected_census.c (only the documented L<=22 gate lines may differ), the predecessor package's own math check, the predecessor's brute-force cross-check of the extended engine over all small splits and all four budget modes with cap and fail-closed controls, and node-exact replay of all six recorded L20/L18 receipts of the pinned package with the extended binary.

Fresh length-22 census replay of the completed exclusion split (11,7) against the committed RESULT.json receipt: must exit 0 with complete=true, zero hits, and the identical node count (8,784,744 nodes). A capped abort or any node drift fails.

Fresh length-22 census replay of the completed exclusion split (10,8) against the committed RESULT.json receipt: must exit 0 with complete=true, zero hits, and the identical node count (597,933,297 nodes). A capped abort or any node drift fails.

Fresh length-22 census replay of the completed exclusion split (11,8) against the committed RESULT.json receipt: must exit 0 with complete=true, zero hits, and the identical node count (1,349,702,650 nodes). A capped abort or any node drift fails.

notes: C11 compiler with unsigned __int128 required (clang or GCC). No Python dependencies. The three completed split exclusions (11,7), (10,8) and (11,8) are replayable by the registered commands; each runs one split under its own timeout. The six capped lower-bound probes (2e9-node cap each, the remaining splits) are NOT re-run by CI: reproduce them with the documented opt-in command `{python} -I -B {package}/verify.py --probe-all-splits` (about 1.4e10 nodes; long). `--probe-cap` lowers the cap for the opt-in measurement (must stay at or below the recorded cap). RESULT.json is the committed receipt and is never rewritten; each run writes LAST-RUN.json. Timing fields are excluded from all equality checks.
